Name: Witness
Description:
You touch a willing creature, creating a magical link from their senses to your own that functions over any distance. For the duration, you can use your action to experience the world through the target's senses, including sight, sound, touch, smell and taste, and any special senses such as darkvision. While doing so, you are blinded, deafened, and restrained, and your own senses of taste, smell and touch are suspended. You can speak normally, but the only actions you can take are to make Wisdom and Intelligence ability checks, or to cast a spell that allows you to communicate with the target (for example, message or sending). You can return to your own senses as a bonus action.

Additionally, if the target takes damage while you are experiencing its senses, you take half the amount as psychic damage.

The spell ends if the target is on a plane of existence different than your own.
